text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS). Given your recent initiation of arthritis medications, the timing of your rash onset, and the new onset cough suggesting potential respiratory involvement, I suspect a severe drug reaction. We need to confirm this with blood work and potentially imaging. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Liver Function Tests (LFTs). REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
